text:
Ivy (Producer): Hey team — kicking off the LaunchPad case study for Altair Robotics. Need: interview, quote approvals, legal release, and a short launch post. Draft Qs & timeline here: https://drive.redwood/launchpad-draft

Priya (PMM): thanks! Quick ask — can we make the customer quote feel product-first not tech-first? suggest one line about 'reduced inference cost' instead of gpu counts.

Maya (Marketing): Also want a 3-sentence benchmark blurb showing 2–3x latency improvement and cost per token change. Can someone confirm numbers? Will use in post + webinar promo.

Jonas (CS): Customer reviewed the draft. They're okay with the sentiment but asked to redact exact monthly API usage. They approved the quote text below but want to remove the '1.2M calls/month' line.

Ivy (Producer): copy of the current quote:
```
"Redwood cut our inference latency by 48% and reduced per-request cost by 37%." — Altair PM
```
Can Legal confirm if that's releaseable? Also scheduling: webinar slot Wed 3/4pm PT — ok?

LegalBot: Heads-up: Need a signed release + PR opt-in form. The quoted metric claims require source attribution; provide the benchmark run id or remove the exact percent figures. If keeping them, send the test command and seed data. Deadline: EOD Wed.

Sam (Sales): I'll route incoming demo requests from the launch to Tess and flag as 'Altair case priority'. Tess, can you take the first 5 leads?

Tess (AE): Yep, I'll take them. Sam please add them to my queue + notes on their infra.

Priya (PMM): Updated draft attached (minor tone edits). Ivy — can you swap the metric line for this variant if Legal pushes back:
"Redwood significantly improved latency and lowered inference costs for Altair's workloads." :thinking:

Ivy (Producer): used the toned-down line and added a timestamped benchmark note in the doc. Ping @LegalBot when you have the signed release. Will mock up two social cards — benchmark-focused and human-story focused. Need headshot + short customer blurb by noon tomorrow.

Maya (Marketing): I'll prep the webinar registration page and the benchmark slide. Can someone drop the validated numbers in #eng-ml? cc @Jonas for accuracy.

Jonas (CS): Dropping the perf snippet in eng-ml in 10m. Also attaching the run id: run_2026-03-20_0089. Will DM Legal the raw logs.

Ivy (Producer): Great — next steps: (1) Legal sign-off + signed release, (2) Customer headshot + blurb, (3) Final quote text, (4) Webinar promo assets by EOD Tue. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
